cases.title: Named day is a bank holiday inside the window
cases.scene: Mr Hall is verified and told his card is 5 days late. He says he will pay the full amount on Monday 9 November. The agent offers the next business day, Tuesday 10 November, and he accepts and confirms.

quotes.quote: If the customer names a weekend day or a holiday that is not after the deadline, offer the next business day.
Ask for the full past-due amount first.
Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes, with `product_id`, `amount` and `date`.

cases.title: Late band: date one business day after the 5th-business-day deadline
cases.scene: Ms Reid is verified and is 15 days late, so she is in the late band. On Wednesday 4 November she asks to pay the full amount on Friday 13 November. The deadline is Thursday 12 November. The agent offers that date and she accepts.

quotes.quote: If the customer asks for a date after the deadline, say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it.
Ask for the full past-due amount first.
Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes, with `product_id`, `amount` and `date`.

cases.title: Relative says the customer has died
cases.scene: A woman answers the call and says Mr Novak died last spring. The agent must not mention the account or ask anything further.

quotes.quote: If the person says the customer has died, say "I am sorry for your loss.", ask nothing else, and close as `not_reached` / `deceased`.

cases.title: Callback at exactly 20:00 today
cases.scene: A flatmate answers and says the customer is out. When asked when the customer can be reached, he says to call back today at 20:00, which is the last allowed minute.

quotes.quote: A callback is for today or the next business day, from 10:00 to 20:00, both included, and later than `now`.
A callback is for today or the next business day, from 10:00 to 20:00, both included, and later than `now`.

cases.title: Callback offered outside the window twice
cases.scene: A relative answers. Asked when the customer can be reached, she says 21:00 tonight. The agent asks once for another time and she says 09:00 tomorrow, which is also outside the window. Nothing is scheduled.

quotes.quote: If the person offers a day or a time outside that window, ask once for another time. If that is also outside it, do not schedule. Close as `not_reached` / `no_callback`.
If the person offers a day or a time outside that window, ask once for another time. If that is also outside it, do not schedule. Close as `not_reached` / `no_callback`.

cases.title: Two wrong identity answers end the check
cases.scene: The customer confirms his name, gives a wrong date of birth, then a wrong postcode. That is two wrong answers in total. The agent does not state the debt and sends him to the statement number or a branch.

quotes.quote: After two wrong answers, do not state the debt. Tell the customer to call the number on their statement or visit a branch. Close as `not_verified` / `failed`.
After two wrong answers, do not state the debt. Tell the customer to call the number on their statement or visit a branch. Close as `not_verified` / `failed`.

cases.title: Offered amount exactly equal to the floor
cases.scene: The customer is verified and is 20 days late. The full amount is 400. She offers to pay exactly the minimum of 50 today. That is exactly at the floor, so it is accepted and she confirms.

quotes.quote: If the customer proposes an amount from the floor up to the full amount, both included, accept it.
A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

cases.title: "Next Friday" on a Wednesday
cases.scene: The customer is verified and is 3 days late. On Wednesday 4 November he says he will pay the full amount next Friday. That means the Friday of the following calendar week, 13 November, not this Friday, 6 November.

quotes.quote: "Next <weekday>" means that weekday in the following calendar week.
Ask for the full past-due amount first.
